court: United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit
rule_established: Fourth Amendment requires search warrant for government access to stored email content regardless of storage age; SCA 180-day rule is unconstitutional for email content; stored email has same constitutional protection as sealed postal mail
circuit: 6th Circuit (persuasive authority in 9th Circuit California courts; DOJ adopted national warrant policy)
